title: Months of Coverage Run While a Covered Piece Is at the Bench
content:
Where coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is given up while the covered piece is with the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, the whole months since the plan was bought are counted against the work order carrying the reference of the claim last entered against the plan.

Where that work order shows no date the piece was handed back and carries a promised date later than the handling date, the whole months since the plan was bought are counted to that promised date, because the coverage keeps answering for the piece until it comes back. Where that work order shows no date the piece was handed back and its promised date is on or before the handling date, the whole months since the plan was bought are counted to the handling date and one more, the month in progress counting as run. In any other case the whole months since the plan was bought are counted to the handling date.

## What is read on the work order

| Date the piece was handed back | Promised date | The whole months since the plan was bought are counted |
|---|---|---|
| none recorded | later than the handling date | to that promised date |
| none recorded | on or before the handling date | to the handling date and one more |
| recorded | any | to the handling date |

## Two readings of a piece still at the bench

A plan bought on the tenth of a month, handled on the tenth of the month 14 months later, with the piece still at the bench and promised back two months after the handling date: the months are counted to that promised date, giving 16 whole months since the plan was bought.

The same plan whose piece is still at the bench but was promised back a month before the handling date: the months are counted to the handling date and one more, giving 15.
